changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.subtitle: The evolution of Retro Game Tracker

v023.title: List View
v023.item1: Added a new List View alongside the existing Large and Small game card views.
v023.item2: Added a compact table displaying game name, platform, completion status, and release year.
v023.item3: Added ascending and descending sorting for all four table columns.
v023.item4: Synchronized List View sorting with the existing sorting dropdown.
v023.item5: Added clickable table rows that open the corresponding Game Details page.
v023.item6: Integrated List View with existing search, platform filters, and status filters.
v023.item7: Saved the selected view mode in local storage so it persists between visits.
v023.item8: Improved accessibility with keyboard navigation and sortable column indicators.

v022.title: My Game Links
v022.item1: Added a dedicated My Game Links section to game details.
v022.item2: Enabled saving multiple useful websites for each game.
v022.item3: Added link names, URLs, and optional categories.
v022.item4: Implemented full link creation, editing, and deletion.
v022.item5: Added confirmation dialogs for deleting saved links.
v022.item6: Introduced clickable link names and category badges.
v022.item7: Matched Edit and Delete buttons to Personal Memory styling.
v022.item8: Secured personal links with Supabase Row Level Security.

v021.title: Achievement Badge Improvements
v021.item1: Introduced circular retro pixel-art achievement badges.
v021.item2: Added automatic PNG loading from images/badges/.
v021.item3: Added Lucide icon fallbacks for missing badge images.
v021.item4: Improved badge alignment, spacing, and label readability.
v021.item5: Standardized game details headings with colored Lucide icons.

v020.title: Personal Achievements
v020.item1: Introduced a universal gaming achievement library.
v020.item2: Added achievement selection and earned badge display.
v020.item4: Saved achievements to Supabase with private user ownership.

v015.title: Personal Memories
v015.item1: Added one personal memory per game.
v015.item3: Implemented memory creation, editing, and deletion.
v015.item4: Added a dedicated empty state and improved memory presentation.

v014.title: Gaming History Improvements
v014.item3: Improved game ownership checks for editing and deleting records.

v013.title: Navigation & Interface
v013.item2: Fixed loading overlay behavior across pages.
v013.item3: Refined game details layout and responsiveness.

v012.title: Game Details
v012.item2: Displayed game information and cover artwork.

v011.title: Collection Management
v011.item2: Introduced favorite and game status tracking.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: This Privacy Policy explains how RetroTrack Games collects, uses, stores, and protects personal information.

information_collect.title: 1. Information We Collect
information_collect.description: When you create an account with RetroTrack Games, we collect the information necessary to provide and maintain your account.
information_collect.email: Email address used for registration and authentication.
information_collect.collection: Games added to your collection, including favorites and completion status.
information_collect.security: Technical authentication and security information needed to operate the service.

information_use.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
information_use.description: RetroTrack Games processes account and collection information to provide and maintain its services.
information_use.accounts: To create, authenticate, and manage user accounts.
information_use.collection: To save and display your personal game collection.
information_use.favorites: To remember your favorites and game completion status.
information_use.management: To provide account management and deletion functionality.
information_use.security: To maintain the security and reliability of the platform.

data_storage.title: 3. Data Storage and Security
data_storage.description_1: RetroTrack Games uses Supabase to provide authentication and database services. Account information and personal game collections are stored using this infrastructure.
data_storage.description_2: Access controls are implemented to restrict access to personal collection information. Authentication and database security measures are used to help protect user data against unauthorized access.

account_deletion.title: 4. Account Deletion and Your Rights
account_deletion.description_1: You can request deletion of your RetroTrack Games account through the account management features provided on the website.
account_deletion.description_2: Depending on applicable data protection laws, including the GDPR, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict, or receive a copy of your personal information. You may also have the right to object to certain processing activities.
account_deletion.description_3: To exercise your privacy rights or ask questions about your personal information, please contact us through our Contact & Support page.

third_party.title: 5. Third-Party Services
third_party.description: RetroTrack Games uses third-party services to operate and maintain the platform.
third_party.supabase: Provides authentication, database storage, and backend functionality.
third_party.github: Hosts the website and delivers its frontend files.
third_party.igdb: Provides video game metadata used to populate the game database.

data_retention.title: 6. Data Retention
data_retention.description_1: RetroTrack Games generally retains account information and personal game collection data for as long as the account remains active.
data_retention.description_2: When an account is deleted, associated personal data is removed according to the platform's deletion procedures, subject to applicable legal obligations and technical retention requirements.
data_retention.description_3: Certain information may remain temporarily in backups or security logs before being deleted according to the relevant retention schedules.

legal_bases.title: 7. Legal Bases for Processing
legal_bases.description: Where the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) applies, RetroTrack Games processes personal information under the following legal bases:
legal_bases.contractual_description: Processing necessary to provide user accounts, authentication, and personal game collections (Article 6(1)(b)).
legal_bases.legitimate_description: Processing necessary to maintain platform security, prevent abuse, and ensure reliable operation, where those interests are not overridden by users' rights (Article 6(1)(f)).
legal_bases.obligations_description: Processing required to comply with applicable laws (Article 6(1)(c)).

data_controller.title: 8. Data Controller and Contact
data_controller.description_1: RetroTrack Games is an independently operated video game collection platform.
data_controller.description_2: For privacy-related questions, requests concerning personal data, or complaints, please contact us through our Contact & Support page.
data_controller.description_3: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent data protection supervisory authority.

cookies.title: 9. Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.original_description: RetroTrack Games uses browser storage technologies to support authentication and maintain user sessions. These technologies help keep users signed in and provide essential application functionality.
cookies.description_1: RetroTrack Games uses browser storage technologies to support authentication, maintain user sessions, and provide essential application functionality.
cookies.description_2: These technologies may include cookies and local storage. The specific technologies used depend on the authentication and hosting services.

international_transfers.title: 10. International Data Transfers
international_transfers.original_description: Some third-party service providers may process information outside the European Economic Area. Where GDPR applies, such transfers must comply with applicable data protection requirements.
international_transfers.description_1: Some third-party service providers may process personal information outside the European Economic Area (EEA).
international_transfers.description_2: Where applicable, international transfers must comply with GDPR requirements, including the use of appropriate transfer safeguards.

children.title: 11. Children's Privacy
children.description_1: RetroTrack Games is a video game collection management platform. Its account registration and use requirements are described in the Terms of Service.
children.description_2: If you believe personal information relating to a child has been processed inappropriately, please contact us so the matter can be reviewed.

automated_decisions.title: 12. Automated Decision-Making
automated_decisions.description: RetroTrack Games does not currently intend to use personal information for automated decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects on users.

changes.title: 13. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.description_1: This Privacy Policy may be updated to reflect changes to RetroTrack Games, its functionality, third-party services, or applicable legal requirements.
changes.description_2: The date displayed at the beginning of this policy indicates when it was last updated. Where required, users will be informed of material changes.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.introduction: These Terms of Service govern access to and use of RetroTrack Games, a platform for exploring video games and managing personal gaming collections.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.description: By accessing or using RetroTrack Games, you agree to these Terms of Service and acknowledge the Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, you should not use the service.

service_description.title: 2. Description of Service
service_description.description_1: RetroTrack Games is a platform for discovering video games, exploring gaming platforms, and managing personal game collections.
service_description.description_2: The service is currently under active development. Features, functionality, and availability may change.

user_accounts.title: 3. User Accounts
user_accounts.description_1: Certain features require a registered account. Users are responsible for providing accurate account information, maintaining the confidentiality of their credentials, and notifying us of suspected unauthorized access.
user_accounts.description_2: Account registration may be restricted or temporarily unavailable during development.

acceptable_use.title: 4. Acceptable Use
acceptable_use.description: Users must not misuse RetroTrack Games or interfere with its operation.
acceptable_use.unauthorized_access: Do not attempt unauthorized access to accounts or systems.
acceptable_use.security: Do not exploit vulnerabilities or circumvent security restrictions.
acceptable_use.disruption: Do not intentionally disrupt the service or overload its infrastructure.
acceptable_use.unlawful: Do not use the platform for unlawful activities.
acceptable_use.content: Do not misuse or redistribute content in violation of applicable rights.

personal_collections.title: 5. Personal Collections
personal_collections.description_1: Users may organize and maintain personal game collections using the features provided by RetroTrack Games.
personal_collections.description_2: Users are encouraged to maintain their own records of important collection information. While reasonable efforts may be made to preserve data, uninterrupted availability or permanent preservation cannot be guaranteed.

intellectual_property.title: 6. Intellectual Property
intellectual_property.description_1: The original design, branding, and independently developed components of RetroTrack Games are subject to applicable intellectual property rights.
intellectual_property.description_2: Video game titles, trademarks, logos, cover artwork, and other third-party materials remain the property of their respective rights holders.

third_party.title: 7. Third-Party Content and Services
third_party.description_1: RetroTrack Games uses third-party services and game information sources, including IGDB, to provide certain functionality and game metadata.
third_party.description_2: Game information may contain inaccuracies, omissions, or outdated details. RetroTrack Games does not claim ownership of third-party game content.

service_availability.title: 8. Service Availability
service_availability.description_1: RetroTrack Games is provided on an as-available basis. Maintenance, technical issues, or development changes may temporarily interrupt access.
service_availability.description_2: Features may be modified, suspended, or discontinued, subject to applicable legal requirements.

account_termination.title: 9. Account Suspension and Termination
account_termination.description_1: Accounts may be restricted or suspended when reasonably necessary to address security threats, misuse, violations of these Terms, or legal requirements.
account_termination.description_2: Users may request account deletion through the available account management features. Personal data handling following deletion is described in the Privacy Policy.

disclaimer.title: 10. Disclaimer of Warranties
disclaimer.description_1: To the extent permitted by applicable law, RetroTrack Games is provided without guarantees of uninterrupted operation, error-free functionality, or complete accuracy of game information.
disclaimer.description_2: Nothing in these Terms excludes warranties or protections that cannot legally be excluded.

liability.title: 11. Limitation of Liability
liability.description_1: To the extent permitted by applicable law, liability arising from the use or unavailability of RetroTrack Games may be limited.
liability.description_2: Nothing in these Terms limits liability where doing so would be prohibited by applicable law or removes mandatory consumer protections.

changes.title: 12. Changes to These Terms
changes.description_1: These Terms may be updated to reflect changes to the service, legal requirements, or operating practices.

welcome.hero_description: Build your personal retro game collection, track your progress, and preserve the memories behind every game you've played. Organize your favorites, explore detailed statistics, and easily add your favorite soundtracks and walkthroughs directly from YouTube.
welcome.collection_description: Create your own personal gaming library. Organize games by platform, genre, developer, and series. Keep track of everything you've played and discover your collection all over again.
welcome.statistics_description: Mark games as completed, in progress, or not played. Record completion dates, follow your achievements, and explore statistics that show how your gaming journey has evolved.
welcome.soundtracks_description: Every great game has unforgettable music. Easily add your favorite soundtracks directly from YouTube and enjoy them alongside your collection. From iconic title themes to memorable background music, keep the sounds of your gaming memories alive.
welcome.walkthroughs_description: Stuck on a difficult level or looking to revisit a classic adventure? Easily add YouTube walkthroughs to your games and keep helpful guides just a click away. Whether you're discovering secrets or reliving old challenges, everything stays connected to your collection.
welcome.game_details_description: Explore individual game pages with cover artwork, release information, genres, developers, and your personal completion status. Keep the details that make each game special together in one place.
welcome.history_description: Every completed game is another chapter in your gaming journey. Look back at the games you've finished, remember when you conquered them, and rediscover the adventures that shaped your love for gaming. Your collection isn't just a list of games — it's your personal history.
welcome.platforms_description: From legendary home consoles to classic computers, explore the platforms that defined your gaming journey. Keep your games organized by system and rediscover the titles that made each platform special.
welcome.cta_title: Ready to Revisit Your Gaming History?
welcome.cta_description: From your very first game to your latest completed adventure, your gaming history deserves a place of its own.
